name: has_high_qs_ranking_education
description: Founder has at least one education with QS ranking 10 or better
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 10 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_executive_role_long_duration
description: Founder has held an executive role for more than 9 years
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(job.get('duration', '')) > 9 for job in founder.get('jobs', []) if 'President' in job.get('role', '') or 'CEO' in job.get('role', ''))

name: industry_includes_tech
expression: lambda founder: 'software' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'technology' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'internet' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: has_education_in_science_or_engineering
description: Founder has at least one degree in a science or engineering field
expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('field', '').lower() in ['computer science', 'engineering', 'biomedical engineering', 'materials science', 'mechanical engineering', 'electrical engineering', 'informatics'] for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_ipo_experience
description: Founder has been involved in an IPO

name: has_acquisition_experience
description: Founder has been involved in an acquisition

name: has_extensive_experience_in_industry
description: Founder has held roles in the same industry for over 6 years
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(job.get('duration', '')) > 6 for job in founder.get('jobs', []) if job.get('industry', '').lower() in founder.get('industry', '').lower())

name: has_multiple_education_degrees
description: Founder has more than one degree

name: has_international_experience
description: Founder has held roles in different industries or sectors indicating diverse experience
expression: lambda founder: len(set(e.get('field', '') for e in founder.get('educations', []))) > 1 or len(set(job.get('industry', '') for job in founder.get('jobs', []))) > 1

name: industry_is_nan_or_empty
description: Founder industry is missing or empty
expression: lambda founder: not founder.get('industry') or founder.get('industry').strip() == ''

name: has_high_number_of_jobs
description: Founder has held more than 5 different roles
expression: lambda founder: len({job.get('role', '') for job in founder.get('jobs', [])}) > 5

name: has_education_in_top_qs_ranking
description: Founder has an education with QS ranking 5 or better
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 5 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_leadership_experience_in_startup
description: Founder has held CEO or President roles in startups for over 2 years
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(job.get('duration', '')) > 2 for job in founder.get('jobs', []) if 'CEO' in job.get('role', '') or 'President' in job.get('role', ''))

name: industry_includes_health
expression: lambda founder: 'health' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'medical' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'healthcare' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: experience_in_education_sector
description: Founder has held roles in education or research sectors
expression: lambda founder: any('professor' in job.get('role', '').lower() or 'research' in job.get('industry', '').lower() for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_multiple_high_qs_education
description: Founder has more than one education with QS ranking in top 50
expression: lambda founder: sum(1 for e in founder.get('educations', []) if parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 50) > 1

name: has_education_in_social_sciences
description: Founder has education in social sciences or humanities
expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('field', '').lower() in ['literature', 'social sciences', 'education', 'psychology', 'philosophy'] for e in founder.get('educations', []))
